name: NIM metadata and paired container
client: curl for metadata; crane 0.22.1 for the paired image
auth: Authorize metadata reads on the nimmodel repository and image reads on a separate Docker remote. AW_TOKEN is the artifactweave user token; the administrator configures any upstream NGC API key independently.
fresh_home: Use fresh DOCKER_CONFIG and a new output archive under AW_WORK; crane has no persistent local image store.
prerequisites: Remote nimmodel repository plus a separate Docker remote for nvcr.io.
AW_IMAGE_REPO is that Docker repository key. Select matching resource ID and image tag from the metadata.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export DOCKER_CONFIG="$AW_WORK/docker"
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
AW_REGISTRY="${AW_URL#*://}"
configure.note: Registry authority includes a port when needed. AW_URL must be a bare HTTPS origin, with no path. Configuration files remain under AW_WORK.

publish.note: NIM repositories are remote-only; no publication command is provided.

install.note: Resolve metadata and pull the corresponding image through its separately authorized Docker remote.

steps.note: nim/meta/llama:1.3 is the controlled test coordinate; substitute the model and tag actually advertised by your upstream.

limitations: The retained proof is metadata HTTP plus a real registry-client pull. It is not proof that the NGC CLI can be pointed at artifactweave.
NIM metadata and Docker image caches are separate; both must be warmed before an offline transfer.

contains: metadata and native Docker pull resolve the same image and tag
